name: Pilchard puttanesca
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 based on standard pasta recipe scaling (300g dry spaghetti typically serves 4 adults) and common BBC Good Food portioning for similar dishes.

Total time estimated at 20 minutes: ~10 min for pasta boiling + ~10 min for sauce preparation and combining, derived from explicit instruction times (3-4 min softening, 1 min puree, 'few more mins' for fish/olives) plus typical pasta cook time.
Pilchards classified as fish (true allergen) due to being a type of small oily fish like sardines; Pescatarian true as it includes fish but no meat.
Wheat true for gluten and wheat allergens due to spaghetti (durum wheat pasta); not gluten-free.
Dairy from Parmesan (milk allergen); not dairy-free.
No explicit eggs, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame in ingredients; set to null as ambiguous without full label disclosure.
Tomato puree, olives, and other items assumed free of major allergens unless inherently containing them.
instructions:
Cook the pasta following pack instructions. Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and cook the onion, garlic and chilli for 3-4 mins to soften. Stir in the tomato purée and cook for 1 min, then add the pilchards with their sauce. Cook, breaking up the fish with a wooden spoon, then add the olives and continue to cook for a few more mins.

Drain the pasta and add to the pan with 2-3 tbsp of the cooking water. Toss everything together well, then divide between plates and serve, scattered with Parmesan.

ingredients.assumptions: Dry spaghetti weight as specified; standard durum wheat pasta values.

ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red chilli ≈20g whole (edible portion after trimming).

ingredients.name: Black Olives
ingredients.assumptions: 70g pitted black olives as specified; standard cured olive values.

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.assumptions: Shaved Parmesan estimated at 20g total for the dish (plausible amount for scattering over 4 servings); hard cheese values.
